name: Puduḫepa
contribution: A Hittite queen, married to the King Hattusili III.
legacy: From the royal palace in the newly rebuilt capital city of Hattusa, this person used her sons and daughters to ensure Hittite ascendancy and to cement alliances.

checks.lead: Puduḫepa or Pudu-Kheba (fl. 13th century BC) was a Hittite queen, married to the King Hattusili III. She has been referred to as "one of the most influential women known from the Ancient Near East."
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
